acceptance_criteria: CalendarAlert struct added. @type and recurrenceId serialize correctly.
close_reason: Added CalendarAlert struct to notification.rs; re-exported from lib.rs; 3 tests (with/without recurrenceId, wire names); 47 tests pass; clippy clean
description:
**What:** Add CalendarAlert struct to notification.rs. Draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §6.4 defines the push payload emitted when a calendar alert fires. Fields: @type (always "CalendarAlert"), accountId (Id), calendarEventId (Id), uid (String), recurrenceId (Option<String> — null if non-recurring), alertId (String).

**Algorithm:**
1. Add to notification.rs:
   #[non_exhaustive]
   #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
   #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
   pub struct CalendarAlert {
       #[serde(rename = "@type")]
       pub at_type: String,        // always "CalendarAlert"
       pub account_id: Id,
       pub calendar_event_id: Id,
       pub uid: String,
       pub recurrence_id: Option<String>,   // null if non-recurring (no skip_serializing_if)
       pub alert_id: String,
   }
2. Re-export from lib.rs.
3. Add round-trip serde tests: with and without recurrenceId. Assert @type serializes to "CalendarAlert".
4. Run cargo test -p jmap-calendars-types.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- @type wire name is "@type" (not atType).
- recurrenceId serializes as null when None.
- cargo test -p jmap-calendars-types exits 0.
title: Add CalendarAlert push-notification struct (calendars-26 §6.4)
